rules.statement: A modal is used only when the page underneath must not proceed; otherwise the content is a section, a drawer or a page.
Focus moves into the dialog on open, is trapped while open and returns to the trigger on close; the trigger is recorded, not guessed.
Escape and the close control always dismiss; a destructive dialog may refuse outside-press dismissal but must say that it does.
Reduced motion removes travel and scaling but keeps the dialog, its focus behaviour and its dismissal routes identical.

motion.reducedMotion: the dialog appears instantly at full size with focus already inside

motion.noneReason: the dialog must not appear to close before it has closed
motion.reducedMotion: the label states the work; the dialog stays open
the dialog closes instantly and focus returns to the trigger

motion.noneReason: an error that fades in reads as optional

stateMachine.staleResponseRule: a dialog closed while a request is in flight ignores the late result rather than reopening

refused.reason: an informational dialog performs no work
